original_requirement: Register a closed-world Short Completion real-Canary approval profile and verify exact Final Review, Maintenance, artifact, and checkpoint closure without changing production behavior or executing a real provider.
operational_definition: Only short_completion_1 documents bound to the exact registered scope, current Plan, launcher, workload, fingerprints, route/provider/pricing manifests, flags, budgets, stop manifest, validator policies, completion definitions, cohort, and window may become a Signed Approval; only a hash-only verifier proving the existing production completion artifacts may report SHORT_WORKFLOW_COMPLETED_AND_FINAL_REVIEW_ACCEPTED.
forbidden_narrowing: Do not treat run.status=completed alone as Short Completion success.
Do not invent or relax production Final Review or Maintenance semantics.
Do not change Prompt, route, retry/fallback, validator, production workflow, StoryState, Canon, or Phase 1B.
Do not create a Signed Approval, reserve a cohort, read credentials, create a provider client, access the network, or invoke a model during materialization.
closed_world_justification: The profile registry, schemas, outcome enum, completion definitions, production artifact locations, budgets, flags, and stop conditions are finite and exact. Unknown profile/scope/schema and any hash drift fail closed.

constraint_traceability.requirement: Closed-world profile and profile-specific approval chain
constraint_traceability.implementation: approval_profiles.py, approval_dispatch.py, and short_completion_approval.py register exact Candidate/Patch/Signed schemas and bindings.
constraint_traceability.evidence: Registry is exactly three profiles; unknown/cross-profile values fail; Candidate/Patch cannot execute or reserve; Signed fixture is exact and single-use.

constraint_traceability.requirement: Exact completion evidence rather than workflow status
constraint_traceability.implementation: short_completion_verification.py reads existing formal manuscript, integrity, quality report/checkpoint, Maintenance receipt, and committed project mutation journal and emits hashes/status only.
constraint_traceability.evidence: Accepted exact binding passes; reject, missing/stale review, revised manuscript, missing/invalid Maintenance, unbound artifact, stale checkpoint, terminal workflow, and unknown parity are typed non-success outcomes.

constraint_traceability.implementation: short_completion_materialization.py and short_completion_closure.py generate inert documents behind FailClosedNetworkSentinel and validate 36 exact checks.
constraint_traceability.evidence: Credential/client/network/model/paid counters are zero, live parity is exact, privacy scan passes, no Signed Approval is materialized, and policy/route/Prompt/flag drift is blocked.

constraint_traceability.requirement: Existing C0B and PA profiles remain compatible
constraint_traceability.implementation: Existing profile definitions and stop manifests are unchanged; dispatch adds a third exact branch only.
constraint_traceability.evidence: Related compatibility cluster passed 88 tests; complete Canary suite passed 217 tests with one skip.

model_output_not_applicable_evidence: SC-AUTH-1 adds no model call, Prompt, parser, adapter, validator, retry, fallback, or production workflow behavior. The verifier consumes only already-persisted hash/status artifacts after the existing workflow ends.
why_previous_tests_missed: The prior c0b_smoke_1 profile intentionally proved only provider-path reachability and mapped run.status=completed directly to WORKFLOW_COMPLETED; it had no profile vocabulary or verifier for Final Review, Maintenance, final artifact, and checkpoint closure.

sibling_boundaries.evidence: Its profile definition, scope, stop manifest, runner handler, and signed schema remain unchanged; compatibility tests pass.
Strict-tool summary selection remains target-filter based; PA goal-stop and materialization tests pass.
The runner invokes ShortCompletionVerificationV1 only for short_completion_1 and publishes independent workflow and completion outcomes.

sibling_boundaries.boundary: Production Short workflow and formal promotion
sibling_boundaries.evidence: src/novel_flywheel and baml_src diffs are empty; verification is post-run and read-only.

remaining_risks: No real provider or full Short workflow was authorized in SC-AUTH-1; the newly materialized Candidate still requires a future named approval and Signed Approval.
